symptom: SOAiaCore persisted evidence/claim/memory lineage but had no generic control that propagated material evidence invalidation to dependent memory or decisions.
root_cause: Lineage structures documented dependency origin but did not compute effective current validity across transitive material dependencies.
early_signals: memory_claim_lineage stores links but no revalidation state
claim_evidence and decision evidence references are persisted without generic downstream invalidation propagation
evidence lifecycle includes SUPERSEDED/REJECTED while derived units can remain independently marked current
human_cost: Risk of presenting historically supported but no-longer-current decisions as still valid; detected autonomously during post-SCN-050 gap analysis.
prevention_rule: Compute effective validity transitively across material dependency edges. SUPERSEDED/STALE/UNKNOWN require revalidation; REJECTED/QUARANTINED invalidate material descendants; historical non-material lineage remains preserved.
